_doc: Allow-list for scripts/figure_freshness.mjs. A figure whose ONLY defect is a source path that lives in the kernel repo (not in this site repo) is reported ALLOWED, never silently passed. Every entry needs a reason, a kernel-relative path that exists in the kernel checkout (verified when the checkout is present), and an EXACT cap = how many figures cite it. A cap higher or lower than the live count fails the run, so caps may only fall as figures are fixed, never rise. total_cap must equal the sum. No source, no checkable path, no date or no system is never allowable here. See scripts/test_figure_freshness_allowlist.mjs.
